text.description_html:
Acorn AZC201, Art Deco Cabinet Knob

The simple answer to the vintage design aesthetic that is so popular. This Acorn made stainless steel cabinet knob is basic enough to effortlessly add just the right amount of retro detailing to your kitchen and bathroom; and also because its design is so simple, this drawer pull is capable of beautifully integrating into whatever furnishing you have without having to overhaul your entire décor. The diameter is 1-1/4 inches while the projection measures 15/16 inches. A

Specifications for the Acorn AZC201 Absolute Zero Collection Deco Nouveau Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 15/16"
